biotools.summary: mulea is an R package for gene set enrichment analysis utilizing multiple ontologies and a progressive empirical false discovery rate method. It offers a comprehensive toolkit for functional enrichment analysis and includes pre-defined ontologies and gene sets for various model organisms.
